audit.why: Even skill lane through level 3 around dodging Tongue Lash, Morgana takes over 4-onward once burst outtrades his short range and a landed root sticks a dashless target for Devour to answer defensively — chart, whys, and phases all already agree.

Level 6 Devour forcing the root-before-eat sequencing, first item widening the burst gap over his short Q range, and late Tahm being a pure peel/save tool are the real spikes and match the kit (R has no cooldown but is reactive, W dive is his only real engage).

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Abyssal Dive as matchup-defining but has no real cooldown number (lint: COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT), and dosFull[1].d / dontsFull[2].d are verbatim copies of tradeGood/tradeBad pasted under unrelated titles (lint: COPY_PASTE_BLEED).
audit.why: Abyssal Dive (W) is 21/20/19/18/17s and Black Shield (E) is 26/23.5/21/18.5/16s — real numbers make the all-in window concrete. The Do/Don't bullets need to independently justify their own titles (root before Devour; Black Shield the Q stun) instead of restating the trade lines.

edits.before: - Tahm Kench Abyssal Dive: matchup-defining — His re-engage and his escape — all-in only while it is down. It writes your spacing rules. - E Black Shield is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: Abyssal Dive (W) is down 21s at rank 1, 17s maxed — all-in only while it's on cooldown. Black Shield (E) is 26s at rank 1, 16s maxed — save it for the dive knockup, not chip. The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.

edits.before: W the pair, bank the Q visibly, shield the answer — the threat governs while the pool bills.
edits.after: Dark Binding roots the carry before he can Devour them out — land it first, every time.

edits.before: Q-poking into shields while their hook waits for yours to be down — the binding is the law; spend it like one.
edits.after: Black Shield eats the Q stun that opens his whole combo — pool it for that, never for chip damage poke.

notes: Fixed the lint-flagged COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT and both COPY_PASTE_BLEED bullets. Tahm Kench is he/him, no misgender hits flagged. Level chart (full phases[].side and content win[]) already agree row-for-row, no chart fix needed.
